# DropShadow

DropShadow is an iOS survival maze game for iPhone and iPad. The player guides a living drop through deadly maze rooms while the Shadow punishes hesitation. The game focuses on short runs, mass management, special abilities, obstacle timing, compass-assisted navigation, and Daily Runs.

## Official URLs

- Website: https://dropshadow.it/
- Launch list: https://dropshadow.it/#signup
- Support: https://dropshadow.it/support
- Privacy: https://dropshadow.it/privacy

## Key Concepts

- Every second has weight.
- Movement spends mass; risky play can recover it.
- The Shadow follows hesitation and adds pressure to every room.
- Special abilities include Dash, Shield, Phase, Wall Erase, and Mass Generator.
- Obstacles include Rotating Gate, Gate, Pistons, Press Wall, Pulse Hazard, Teleport, and Crumbling Tile.
- Daily Runs give every player the same room and the same rules.
